Classified ESTIMATED because source placement, current whole-quarter extent, lineage, reference period and reuse rights remain unresolved. No fitted shift, correction, snapping, clipping, repair, simplification, buffering, densification, closure or invented edge. Current OSM points and municipal historical labels corroborate names only; neither generates nor fits boundaries.

The cause and the more accurate source are unestablished. This is not an accuracy bound; no correction is fitted. Source/polygon overlaps are retained and reported rather than repaired.
